items.title: Tackling these 14 dementia risk factors can almost halve the chance of onset
items.description: Too many Australians still see dementia as an inevitability, according to new data but there is a list of steps you can take to reduce the risks.

items.title: Small business Yarn'n says Labor's capital gains tax plan 'handcuffs' ambition
items.description: Small business owners are urging Labor to rethink more than just the eligibility thresholds for capital gains tax concessions.

items.title: Iran fires missile at US air base in Kuwait in retaliation for attack
items.description: US President Donald Trump says he is not yet satisfied by negotiations to end the war in Iran, and the US is not discussing easing sanctions, which is one of Tehran's key demands.

items.title: Details of first NZYQ Nauru deal payment revealed
items.description: Details of the secretive NZYQ resettlement deal have emerged, including a breakdown of the government's first payment.

items.title: How tax rules benefit top earners by $700,000 but median earners by $5,700
items.description: Commonwealth Treasury secretary Jenny Wilkinson says the average top income earner benefited from the existing investment tax arrangements to the tune of $700,000 over their lifetime, versus just $5,700 for median income earners.

items.title: 'Horrible' heatwave has Brits wondering if their country is built for heat
items.description: As the mercury climbed around the United Kingdom this week and new May maximums were recorded in multiple areas, the once-welcome sunshine is sparking alarm among many people.

items.title: French Open favourite loses to 56th-ranked amid dizzy spell
items.description: Jannik Sinner's French Open campaign is over after the world number one struggled with illness in a shock second-round defeat to Juan Manuel Cerúndolo.

items.title: Live: AG defends immunity claim for counterterrorism documents
items.description: The Attorney-General has defended the government's decision to block the antisemitism royal commission from accessing counterterrorism funding documents. Follow live.

items.title: Officeworks to offshore hundreds of jobs in search for white collar workers
items.description: The Australian office products retailer is planning to offshore hundreds of jobs to India and the Philippines, joining a growing trend of businesses hoping to find more highly-skilled white collar workers overseas.

items.title: AFP defends public arrest of Ben Roberts-Smith
items.description: The Australian Federal Police has detailed intelligence surrounding Ben Roberts-Smith's arrest, pushing back against criticisms of its public nature.

items.title: Aspiring home owner loses $36,000 deposit in failed 'modular home' project
items.description: It was lauded as a solution to the housing crisis, but those involved say plans to build an "eco village" in northern New South Wales have gone awry.

items.title: 20 million illegal vapes seized by border force in just over two years
items.description: More than 20 million illegal vapes, with a street value of just over $1 billion, have been seized by law enforcement authorities since Australia's vaping reforms came into effect.

items.title: Labor campaigned on 'integrity' so the NACC should be enjoying public trust by now
items.description: In an extraordinary irony, the National Anti-Corruption Commission has become best known for "own goals", rocked by internal scandals and attracting a litany of complaints.

items.title: Friday news quiz: A drone drama, a 'dream job' and an old insult making a comeback
items.description: Your hopes of passing might come crashing down like so many drones in a harbour. But it's still worth a try.

items.title: Forget Drake, these were the 10 best albums released in May
items.description: From long-awaited comebacks to First Nations glam rock and genre-defying polymaths, May was stacked with excellent new releases.

items.title: The Aussie rocker who mastered the video game needle drop
items.description: Melbourne's Johnny Galvatron gave up the rockstar life to become a BAFTA-winning game developer. Now, his studio's latest release, Mixtape, re-imagines the music game as an eclectic playlist of genres and mechanics.

items.title: After escaping sexual slavery, Yazidis re-traumatised by return of 'ISIS brides'
items.description: The return of several 'ISIS brides' from Syria has been re-traumatising for Australian Yazidis, many of whom escaped sexual slavery at the hands of the terrorist organisation.

items.title: Austrian man jailed for Taylor Swift concert terror plot
items.description: A man who plotted but ultimately failed to launch a terrorist attack at Taylor Swift concert in Vienna, forcing the pop star to cancel three performances, is sentenced to 15 years behind bars.

items.title: Live: ASX to rise after tech rally on Wall Street
items.description: Oil prices have dropped again as investors hope for peace in the Middle East and an end to the global energy shock. Follow the day's events and insights as they happen with our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: What does it mean to be the best jack of all trades, but master of none?
items.description: Elite athletes are constantly striving for perfection — an extra millisecond shaved off their time or another centimetre on their distance — but for heptathletes like Tori West, the equation is a little bit harder.

items.title: Australia's Kasatkina sets up French Open clash with top seed Sabalenka
items.description: Daria Kasatkina will face world number one Aryna Sabalenka in the third round as fellow Australian Kimberly Birrell departs the singles draw in Paris.

items.title: This herb could halt a major NT gas project
items.description: The NT government is arguing its planned mega Middle Arm gas industry precinct will be needed to help shore up Australia's future fuel and energy supplies — but it has just identified that a tiny endangered herb could be growing in the way.

items.title: Netanyahu directs Israel's military to take over 70 per cent of Gaza
items.description: Israel effectively controls an estimated 64 per cent of Gaza, now bombarded to ruins by Israel's two-year military assault that followed the 2023 Hamas attack on southern Israel.

items.title: Trump says Murdoch indicated he would 'handle' newspaper's Epstein story
items.description: In refiling his lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal, the US president alleges that Rupert Murdoch indicated that a story about his ties to Jeffrey Epstein would not be published.

items.title: Kids protest against McDonald's after fast-food giant buys land in small town
items.description: Children turn out in protest after it's revealed the global fast-food giant has paid $4.6 million for a prominent site in central Victoria's Castlemaine.
